summary: Phase 4B Shareable Result Cards + How to Play refresh verified end-to-end on desktop 1920px and mobile 390px. All three share cards (share-play, share-test, share-match) render with correct dynamic values, correct mode labels (3R / 5R / 10R, Test Mode, Match / Fill), aria-labeled Copy buttons, aria-live status, clipboard actually populated with the intended summary text, and graceful hiding of the native share button in headless Chromium. How to Play copy refresh matches spec (title The rules in 60 seconds., 3/5/10-round intro, five steps, accessibility-note mentioning Audio and Voice + Professor Flock, scoring table with +0 to +30/+25/+20/+15/+10/+5). Play 3R -> summary -> share card -> save leaderboard flow works, share card renders BEFORE save-section (DOM order verified). Play 5R and 10R deep links initialize correctly (Round 1 / 5, Round 1 / 10). No horizontal overflow at 390px on how-to-play, play landing, learn/test, learn/match. 0 console errors across all flows. No em dashes on how-to-play. No backend regressions observed; TEST_ leaderboard row was created and then admin-deleted successfully via /api/admin/leaderboard/{id}.
tests_executed: GET /how-to-play desktop 1920px: title 'The rules in 60 seconds.', intro mentions 3-round, 5-round, 10-round; 5 step blocks; accessibility-note contains Audio + Voice + Professor Flock; scoring table exposes all six sub-scores with correct point ranges (+0 to +30, +25, +20, +15, +10, +5); no em dashes.

Play /play?rounds=3 full 3-round completion (dynamic min_services=4/3/3 respected). Final summary shows session-total 96.0 / 300. share-play-card renders BEFORE save-section (DOM compareDocumentPosition verified). Card shows Mode 3R, Final session total 96 / 300, Rounds completed 3, https://cloudforge-cards.emergent.host/. Copy button aria-label='Copy result to clipboard'. No native share button present (canNativeShare()=false in headless). Clicking share-play-copy sets share-play-status 'Result copied to your clipboard.' and clipboard actually contains 'I scored 96 in 3R on CloudForge Cards...'. Leaderboard save then works (toast 'New 3-round personal best saved for TEST_i10_1783112104.', save-section hidden after submit).
Play /play?rounds=5 and ?rounds=10 deep links initialize with round-title 'Round 1 / 5' and 'Round 1 / 10' respectively, no errors.

Test Mode /learn/test: completed 15Q quiz, results screen loads. share-test-card content: Mode Test Mode, Score 27% correct, Correct 4 of 15, APP_URL present. share-test-copy has aria-label='Copy result to clipboard'. No native share. Copy click yields share-test-status 'Result copied to your clipboard.' and clipboard='I completed Test Mode on CloudForge Cards and scored 27%...'.

Match /learn/match: completed 5 pipelines, results screen loads. share-match-card content: Mode Match / Fill, Score 13% correct, Pipelines 5, APP_URL present. share-match-copy aria-label='Copy result to clipboard'. No native share. Copy click sets share-match-status 'Result copied to your clipboard.' and clipboard='I completed Match / Fill Mode on CloudForge Cards and scored 13%...'.
Mobile 390px: /how-to-play, /play, /learn/test, /learn/match all report scrollWidth==clientWidth (390==390). No horizontal overflow.
0 console errors across all six test runs. cdn-cgi/rum failures were absent in this pass.
Admin cleanup: DELETE /api/admin/leaderboard/{id} with X-Admin-Token from backend/.env removed the TEST_i10_1783112104 row (HTTP 200, deleted:true).
critical_code_review_comments: utils/shareResults.js: copyText correctly tries navigator.clipboard first then falls back to hidden textarea + execCommand, and never throws. buildShare omits any field that is not Number.isFinite (overflow, roundsCompleted, correct, total) so partial data does not render empty rows. Good.

components/ShareResultCard.jsx: status uses aria-live='polite' region and the fallback status uses AlertCircle icon plus text (not color alone), meeting the accessibility requirement. Native Share button is guarded by canNativeShare() so it is simply omitted in headless / desktop browsers without navigator.share.

Play.jsx wraps ShareResultCard between final-architect-review and save-section blocks; DOM order verified via compareDocumentPosition. Values passed are pre-rounded (Number(sessionTotal.toFixed(1))) so the card can show 96 rather than 96.00000001. Consistent with sub-header total 96.0.
LearnTest.jsx and LearnMatch.jsx pass percent/correct/total straight from server-side graded result; no client-side re-computation. Good separation.
How to Play accessibility-note is a distinct box outside the steps list with its own data-testid; it references both the Audio and Voice controls and Professor Flock explicitly, satisfying the spec.
No em dashes were detected on /how-to-play (verified via string search for U+2014). US English preserved throughout share strings ('student-built AWS learning tool').
APP_URL is a single source of truth in shareResults.js. If the deployed domain changes, only one constant needs to be updated.
test_credentials: None required. ADMIN_TOKEN read from /app/backend/.env used only for post-test cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted leaderboard entry TEST_i10_1783112104 (3-round official, score 96.0). Row removed via DELETE /api/admin/leaderboard/ea6844a4-e7bc-46ae-9103-eb658feffea7 with X-Admin-Token cf-admin-***. localStorage 'cf_player_name', 'cf_my_score', 'cf_my_scores' were written by the leaderboard save on the test machine; not cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4B share/copy feature is stable. Native share cannot be exercised in headless Chromium (navigator.share is undefined) so canNativeShare() returns false and the Share button is hidden by design; this is the expected graceful path and matches the spec. To exercise nativeShare() a real mobile browser is needed. Clipboard write DOES work in Playwright when 'clipboard-read'/'clipboard-write' permissions are granted to the origin; verified via navigator.clipboard.readText() on all three flows. Full Play 5R and 10R end-to-end runs were skipped for time; they share the exact same ShareResultCard code path exercised by 3R and the modeLabel is templated as `${rounds}R`. If deeper regression is desired, run one 5R and one 10R full session and confirm the card shows '5R' / '10R' and '/ 500' / '/ 1000' respectively.
